Our Destinations

Five stops, each one unforgettable

Stop 1 / 5
🇩🇪
Germany · Black Forest Region

Lahr

♥
Who We're Seeing Mike, Magda, Diana, Jan, Bella & little Lenny

About Lahr

Nestled at the edge of the magical Black Forest in southwest Germany, Lahr is a charming town with a beautiful historic centre, gorgeous parks, and an incredibly warm community vibe. The perfect soft start to our big summer trip!

What to Explore

Wander the old town's half-timbered houses, stroll through the lovely Stadtpark, and take a dreamy drive into the Black Forest. The weekly markets are bursting with local food, flowers, and handmade treasures.

Taste of Lahr

Black Forest cake, crispy Flammkuchen, and gorgeous Rhine valley wines. Baden cuisine is seriously underrated and we are going to eat SO well here.

Stop 2 / 5
🇩🇪
Germany · Baden-Württemberg

Ulm

♥
Who We're Seeing Simona & Matias

About Ulm

Birthplace of Einstein and home to the tallest church in the world (161m!), Ulm is an absolute gem on the Danube river. Cobblestone streets, medieval rooftops, and the most charming Fisherman's Quarter you have ever seen.

What to Explore

Climb 768 steps up the Minster tower for jaw-dropping views, discover the wonky medieval houses of the Fisherman's Quarter leaning over the river, and take a romantic evening walk along the Danube promenade.

Taste of Ulm

Ulmer Spatz pastries shaped like little sparrows, hearty Swabian Maultaschen pasta, and local Dinkel wheat beer. Quirky, delicious, and completely unique to here.

Stop 3 / 5
🇭🇺
Hungary · Central Europe

Budapest

About Budapest

Straddling the Danube between Buda and Pest, Budapest is one of Europe's most spectacular and romantic cities. Grand thermal baths, a stunning Parliament building, ruin bars, and legendary nightlife — impossible not to fall in love.

What to Explore

Cross the iconic Chain Bridge at sunset, soak in the Széchenyi thermal baths, climb up to Buda Castle for panoramic views, explore the Great Market Hall, and discover the famous ruin bars of the Jewish Quarter.

Taste of Budapest

Goulash soup, chimney cake (Kürtőskalács), lángos topped with sour cream and cheese, and Hungarian Tokaji wine. The food scene here is incredible and absurdly affordable.

Stop 4 / 5
🇷🇴
Romania · Transylvania

Sibiu

♥
Who We're Seeing Family time back home

About Sibiu

Welcome to the jewel of Transylvania! One of Europe's most enchanting medieval cities, tucked into the Carpathian Mountains. Nicknamed the City with Eyes for its adorable dormer windows that peek from every rooftop.

What to Explore

Hang out in the gorgeous Grand Square, cross the legendary Bridge of Lies, visit the ASTRA open-air museum, and explore the fairytale Transylvanian countryside and fortified churches nearby.

Taste of Sibiu

Sarmale, mici with mustard, and cozonac sweet bread. Wash it all down with local Transylvanian wine or homemade țuică plum brandy. Incredible food, every time.

Stop 5 / 5
🇮🇹
Italy · Campania

Amalfi

About the Amalfi Coast

Just. Us. Two. A UNESCO World Heritage coastline where dramatic cliffs drop into the most turquoise water you have ever seen, and colourful villages cling impossibly to the hillsides. Our romantic finale.

What to Explore

Explore dreamy Positano, elegant Ravello, and the town of Amalfi itself. Boat trips, the Path of the Gods hike, pebble beaches, hidden grottos, and gelato at every turn. No rush, no plans, just vibes.

Just For Us

No schedule, no agenda. Lazy mornings, seaside lunches, afternoon swims, and long candlelit dinners overlooking the sea as the sun sets. Two years of us, celebrated in the most beautiful place on Earth.

Taste of Amalfi

Fresh seafood pasta, limoncello from the famous local lemons, wood-fired pizza Napoletana, and buffalo mozzarella. Every single meal here is a celebration.
